name: EncounterEnd Fixture
remarks: Hand-authored GMF fixture (2026-08-08, notes/ADRs.md ADR-0082,
AR-EE-3): the close-encounter-if-open idiom anemia/anemia_sub.json's
own 'End Any Active Encounter Just In Case' state authors -- an
EncounterEnd on a path where the encounter may or may not still be
open, relying on upstream's own A5 no-op arm (State.java's
EncounterEnd.process, the pin components/patient-simulator/docs/
gmf-interpreter.md cites). This project's own authored data, not
derived from or copied out of any real Synthea module -- no NOTICE/
provenance obligation, the same disposition death-fixture.json's own
header already establishes.
Minimal on purpose, the exact shape ADR-0071/ADR-0072's own
deferred-module incident diagnosed: Open opens an encounter (A1);
Close ends it normally, referencing the tracked open index (A1);
Close_Again immediately re-fires EncounterEnd with nothing open
(A5) -- witnessed pre-fix (ADR-0082, in-session, not committed red):
the retired index-of-last-open-encounter is openness-blind, so
Close_Again reused Close's OWN already-consumed reference (both
citing Open's index) rather than recognizing nothing was open --
not the nil this fixture's first draft assumed, but the SAME
dangling-reference family (AR-EE-1's own 'already has a matching
earlier end' clause). Post-fix: no event at all for Close_Again, an
ordinary transition, the walk's own :suppressed-encounter-ends
counter incremented instead.
